description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt project for platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures. It defines functions for checking the image, copying necessary binaries and data, and performing upgrades based on board names.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that performs a simple check on the firmware image, returning success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade process based on the board's name.
